696503.rationale: Diomande chose PSG over Liverpool (The Athletic, ~Jul 1), and PSG are in advanced talks (AFP Jul 9) and close to a five-year contract. Bild (Jul 15) says Leipzig will only sell with a loan-back.

243962.rationale: Romano (via ReadManCity, Jul 9) says Real Madrid ruled out a move this summer. TEAMtalk (Jul 14) says contract talks with City are set for August, so a move this summer looks unlikely; if he does move, Real remain the most natural destination.

72574.rationale: Fiorentina declined the EUR10m option and he is not in Paratici/Grosso's plans (fiorentinanews/Romano, Jun 24). De Zerbi has told him he has no future at Spurs, so he is for sale with no concrete suitor found.

918938.rationale: PSG are most closely linked (Luis Enrique is a fan; Moretto, Jul 12). The Athletic (Jul 13) says Atletico are not pursuing him this summer, and RAC1 says Atletico want him on a free in 2027. Barca want to renew after signing Adeyemi.

459381.rationale: There is no new July news. Juve's Ottolini-led interest dates from June, and Juve now have a new management (Carnevali/Massara, Jul 8). Spence started the World Cup semi-final for England, which raises his value.

160265.rationale: Fenerbahce reportedly agreed personal terms (EUR9m/yr for 3 years) and raised their offer to EUR35m (tv100, Jul 15). Villa say they will not sell (BirminghamLive, Jul 13). No other club is active, and Sports Mole (Jul 15) says Arsenal and Man Utd are not planning a move.

770763.rationale: The Telegraph (Jul 3) says Arsenal, driven by Arteta, are interested, with Villa valuing him at GBP60m. Emery won't sell (Football Insider, Jul 8), and Liverpool and Spurs links are older.

225772.rationale: In June it was reported 'effectively formalised', but on Jul 3 football.london still called it only a link. Spurs then completed Fernandes and Tonali (to Jul 15) without Savinho and are linked with other wingers (Rogers, Mbaye), so the deal looks stalled.

248237.rationale: Personal terms with Man Utd exist, and Harwood (Jul 8) said talks would accelerate. However, Romano calls the move 'cold' with no bid, and United signed Santos (Jul 13) and Tielemans (Jul 15) instead. Brighton want GBP70-80m.

767460.rationale: Atletico have identified him as a leading target, and Maresca is open to a sale at about EUR60m (ReadManCity, Jul 9). Galatasaray (loan) and Juventus are earlier links, and Barcelona dropped off after signing Adeyemi.

974146.rationale: He is a free agent after Al-Ittihad, and Brazil are out of the World Cup. His Real Madrid comment (Jul 8, 'best club in the world') was a generic answer, not a real lead. Correio do Povo (Jul 8) says a Brazil return is possible (Fluminense). Fenerbahce were an earlier priority link.

222955.rationale: Man City intensified talks and want him immediately (TEAMtalk/CaughtOffside, Jul 15; Guardian: GBP85m; The Athletic: sign and loan back). Arsenal are reportedly cooling and turning to other midfielders, and Lille prefer a 2027 deal or a loan-back.

388162.rationale: UNCHANGED. Lance (Jul 5): Allan and Flaco Lopez attract the most interest, and Palmeiras want more than EUR40m and only sell for an irresistible bid. No new suitor has been named, and the Brazil window runs Jul 20 to Sep 11.

623398.rationale: UNCHANGED. No new reports in July. He was benched for Algeria's World Cup last-32 exit (Jul 3), and Como signed Kaiki in June.

588637.rationale: UNCHANGED (no search budget left). Juve's new management say a centre-forward is a priority (Gazzetta, Jul 14), and Fenerbahce are still hunting a striker.

127253.rationale: UNCHANGED. Arsenal are open to offers (TEAMtalk, Jul 9) and football.london (Jul 13) expects a fee of only GBP10-15m. No new suitor has been reported, and Everton remain the long-standing English option.

875467.rationale: Anderson is done at up to GBP116m (Al Jazeera, Jul 2). Rogers could beat it, since Villa want GBP130m and TEAMtalk says the deal could reach about GBP116m. Tonali (GBP92.5-100m) and Fernandes (GBP85m) fall short, and Diomande is heading to PSG.
